layers.process: Masaya Volcano National Park: Resolución Ministerial 002-2023 (La Gaceta no. 19, 2 February 2023) sets different entry prices for national and non-national visitors, with a daytime rate (8:30 to 16:30) and a separate night rate. Prices set in US dollars are paid in córdobas at the Central Bank of Nicaragua's rate on the payment day. The price table itself was not readable on the page, so no amounts are recorded. MARENA's July 2026 notice gives opening hours as Monday to Sunday, 8:30 to 19:00.
